title: Cardinals fire defensive coordinator Nick Rallis after blowout loss to Chiefs: 'We needed a change, a fresh voice'

sources.title: Cardinals fire defensive coordinator Nick Rallis after blowout loss to Chiefs: 'We needed a change, a fresh voice'
sources.description: The Cardinals have the worst record in the NFC and rank 31st in the league in points allowed. Their struggles go deeper than their defense.
